{{Stub}} {{Location Tabs}} {{Location Infobox |title = Mingting |image = |type = City |map = Solaris-3 |event = |nation = Huanglong }} '''Mingting''' is the capital of [[Huanglong]]. It is the nation's political, economic, and cultural hub. While it is not entirely clear which, if any, of the provinces the city resides in, Qiuyuan's Resonator Showcase[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8o12Z2ejpBc Wuthering Waves | Resonator Showcase | Qiuyuan — MASTER] implies it is near [[Chongzhou]]. It is known to house the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, the Ministry of War, the Internal Security Agency, the Censorate,[[A Stranger in a Strange Land|Chapter II, A Stranger in a Strange Land]] and the Institute of Art[[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]]. ==Resonators== ===Playable=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Playable Resonators&Mingting}} ===Upcoming=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Upcoming Resonators&Mingting}} ==Government== ===Former Members=== {| class="article-table" !Icon!!Name!!Position |- | |[[Xinyi]] |Unknown important former position.
